prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Turkish woman — the personification of the city of Istanbul — one woman who IS Istanbul as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a boyish, mischievous tomboy energy; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; softly rounded face that still tapers to a small chin; eyes on the larger side of natural — almond-shaped eyes of natural size, outer eye corners slightly lifted; brows with a clean, angled peak; a nose with a soft, rounded tip and natural width; medium-full lips of natural width; honey-gold eyes; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; short cropped hair with side-swept bangs; dark lead-grey hair with a soft silver sheen.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: a composed, self-assured look.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: gaslamp-fantasy dress of a storybook steam city cut to the outfit silhouette below — fine wool, silk, lace and soft leather with polished brass buttons, buckles and clockwork filigree, a little gear-and-crystal brooch; clean, elegant and adventurous, gleaming brass and glass, never sooty or rusty.
City motif: a little hat shaped like the tower's conical cap — a round cobalt band ringed with tiny arched windows under a tall, pointed cone of lead-grey silk tipped with a brass finial; on her back folding glider wings of ivory silk stretched over polished brass ribs, painted with turquoise saz leaves and the curling waves of the strait.
World marks on her: polished brass buttons and buckles; clockwork filigree; little gears and glass lenses as jewelry; tinted brass goggles worn as a hair ornament; a pocket watch on a fine chain; a ribbon of white steam curling around her; warm gaslight glinting on brass; feathers and silk ribbons; fine leather gloves; delicate brass instruments clipped to her belt.
Silhouette: a harness of brass clockwork wings spreading wide from her back over a fitted vest — the clockwork wings make the shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: Iznik turquoise, cobalt blue, Ottoman red — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a little brass wind vane on a short handle, its tiny cups spinning and a tulip-red silk streamer fluttering from its tip; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her elegant outfit shows skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a low neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs under a short hem or above tall laced boots; the brass ornaments stay neat and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a storybook gaslamp-fantasy Istanbul on a soft golden evening: paddle-wheel ferries puffing clean white steam as they cross the strait between Europe and Asia; a long two-level bridge over the golden inlet, anglers' lines dangling from its upper rail and lamp-lit tea rooms along its lower deck; on the hill above, a round stone tower crowned with a tall conical cap, flyers on silk-and-brass gliders launching from its high gallery into the wind; painted wooden mansions along the water's edge; the domes and slender minarets of the old city glowing across the water; airships with striped balloons drifting overhead, and gas lamps and pierced brass lanterns lighting the steep stepped lanes.
This card: on the high stone gallery ringing the top of the conical-capped tower at dusk, the gaslit roofs of the hill falling away below her and paddle-wheel ferries crossing the golden strait toward the far shore.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
